{"metadata":{"description":"DSH Claude Style Reasoning Slider is a DeepSeek Harness (DSH) client UI plugin that replaces the native model selector with a Claude-style animated reasoning-effort slider and model picker.DSH Claude Style Reasoning Slider 是一个面向 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的客户端 UI 插件，用于将原生模型选择器替换为带 Clau","id":"gh:1335142815","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"DSH-Claude-Style-Reasoning-Slider","slug":"MEMZ-JZY/DSH-Claude-Style-Reasoning-Slider","topics":["dsh-plugin","dsh-plugin-market","dsh-plugins"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DSH Claude Style Reasoning Slider is a DeepSeek Harness (DSH) client UI plugin that replaces the nat"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"ive model selector with a Claude-style animated reasoning-effort slider and model picker.DSH Claude "},{"id":"p1s3","text":"Style Reasoning Slider 是一个面向 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的客户端 UI 插件，用于将原生模型选择器替换为带 Clau"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# DSH Claude Style Reasoning Slider"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"An animated reasoning-effort slider and model picker for **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)**.
It replaces the"},{"id":"p3s2","text":" native model selector's `conversation.input.model` slot with a
compatible selector whose reasoning "},{"id":"p3s3","text":"pane is a Claude-style animated slider."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"> 🇨🇳 中文版说明请见 README.zh.md"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Preview"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- **Drop-in model selector** — replaces only the `conversation.input.model` slot;
the rest of the ch"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"at input stays untouched.
- **Canonical effort slider** — always shows `Off | Low | Medium | High | "},{"id":"p7s3","text":"Extra | Max`
positions, regardless of how the provider names its levels.
- **Tolerant name matching*"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"* — aliases such as `off`, `none`, `disabled`,
`ultracode` → `max`, `med` → `medium`, `extreme` → `e"},{"id":"p7s5","text":"xtra`, and similar
display names are mapped to canonical slider positions.
- **Unsupported levels st"},{"id":"p7s6","text":"ay visible** — a level the current model does not
support is dimmed but remains clickable. Clicking "},{"id":"p7s7","text":"it keeps the thumb on the
chosen slot and applies the nearest supported level **below** it, with a t"},{"id":"p7s8","text":"oast
explaining the downgrade.
- **Model switching preserves effort** — when you switch models, the "},{"id":"p7s9","text":"current
effort is kept when possible, or automatically downgraded to the nearest
supported level bel"},{"id":"p7s10","text":"ow it (with a toast).
- **Default and adapter-specific strengths** — `Default` is offered as a pill
"},{"id":"p7s11","text":"below the slider and submits without `reasoningEffort` (the provider's own
default applies). Other p"},{"id":"p7s12","text":"rovider strengths that do not map to a canonical
slider position are also shown as selectable pills."},{"id":"p7s13","text":"
- **Models without reasoning metadata stay manageable** — when DSH does not
expose `reasoning`/`eff"},{"id":"p7s14","text":"orts` for the selected model (for example some
OpenRouter or hand-declared custom entries), the Effo"},{"id":"p7s15","text":"rt menu still appears:
it shows a short “no effort levels” notice plus the safe `Default` pill,
inst"},{"id":"p7s16","text":"ead of hiding every thinking-strength control.
- **Liang Calibrator (滑动变祖器)** — optional, off by def"},{"id":"p7s17","text":"ault. Binds the six
canonical levels to stage names: `Off → 小难梁`, `Low → 牢梁`,
`Medium → 梁子`, `High →"},{"id":"p7s18","text":" 梁圣`, `Extra → 梁神`, `Max → 梁祖`. When enabled,
a 31-frame portrait (`frame-00`…`frame-30`) appears ab"},{"id":"p7s19","text":"ove the slider and
follows the thumb continuously while dragging, then snaps to the segment's
first "},{"id":"p7s20","text":"frame on release. Labels and the trigger show `Max 梁祖`-style suffixes.
The setting persists in `loca"},{"id":"p7s21","text":"abels and the trigger show `Max 梁祖`-style suffixes.
The setting persists in `localStorage`.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"Install the bundle from the Git repository:"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"Or use a local checkout:"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Restart the web profile after installing or removing the bundle."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## Usage"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"1. Click the model/effort trigger chip in the conversation input.
2. In the popup menu, choose **Mod"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"el** to switch models, or **Effort** to adjust
the reasoning level of the current model.
3. In the e"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"ffort pane:
- Drag or click the slider to pick `Off`, `Low`, `Medium`, `High`, `Extra`,
or `Max`.
- "},{"id":"p15s4","text":"If a position is unsupported, the thumb stays where you clicked and the
nearest supported level belo"},{"id":"p15s5","text":"w is applied; a toast tells you what happened.
- Click **Default** to remove `reasoningEffort` and l"},{"id":"p15s6","text":"et the provider decide.
- Click any extra pill to apply a provider-specific strength that does not
m"},{"id":"p15s7","text":"ap to a slider position.
- If the model has no declared reasoning levels, the pane shows a notice
an"},{"id":"p15s8","text":"d only the **Default** pill. For providers that do support effort but
are configured without `reason"},{"id":"p15s9","text":"ingEfforts` (common with custom OpenRouter
routes), add the levels in DSH's `llm-pi-ai` settings to "},{"id":"p15s10","text":"get the full
slider back.
4. When switching models, the plugin preserves the current effort level wh"},{"id":"p15s11","text":"ere
supported; otherwise it downgrades to the nearest supported level below or
falls back to `Defaul"},{"id":"p15s12","text":"t`, always with a toast.
5. To enable the **Liang Calibrator**, click the `滑动变祖器` switch below the
t"},{"id":"p15s13","text":"rack. The portrait and stage-name suffixes turn on immediately; the state
is remembered across sessi"},{"id":"p15s14","text":"ons.
6. To enable the **Big Fat Fish thumb**, open DSH **Settings → General** and turn
on **Big Fat "},{"id":"p15s15","text":"Fish slider**. The thumb changes immediately without a restart."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## UI effects"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"- **Trigger chip** — shows the current model and effort label, six rising
signal bars that fill with"},{"id":"p17s2","text":" the current level, and a chevron. At `Max` the
effort label flows as a purple gradient. With the Li"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"ang Calibrator enabled it
also shows stage suffixes such as `Max 梁祖`.
- **Two-level popup menu** — a"},{"id":"p17s4","text":" compact menu with a model list (grouped by
provider) and an effort pane; loading/error/retry states"},{"id":"p17s5","text":" are included.
- **Glass track** — inner bevel shadows and a subtle fractal-noise layer break
up fla"},{"id":"p17s6","text":"t-color banding.
- **Light field** — the track responds to the pointer like a light source: an
inter"},{"id":"p17s7","text":"ior light pool and a glass-edge highlight follow the cursor, brightening
as the pointer approaches a"},{"id":"p17s8","text":"nd fading with distance. The light is suppressed
at `Max` so the pixel field stays clean.
- **Level "},{"id":"p17s9","text":"labels** — faint tick labels; the current level is always shown,
hovering near a slot highlights it,"},{"id":"p17s10","text":" and others stay barely visible.
- **Liang portrait** — when the Liang Calibrator is enabled, a `224"},{"id":"p17s11","text":"px` square
portrait appears above the track. It uses 31 WebP frames (`frame-00`…
`frame-30`) that ch"},{"id":"p17s12","text":"ange continuously while dragging and keep the original
scanline + light-spot texture.
- **Liang togg"},{"id":"p17s13","text":"le indicator** — the `滑动变祖器` switch below the track uses a
dot indicator: a gray dot when off, a glo"},{"id":"p17s14","text":"wing purple dot when on.
- **High / Extra dot-matrix ripple** — `High` (blue) and `Extra` (purple) s"},{"id":"p17s15","text":"how a
sparse particle field that expands from the thumb, flickers randomly, and
animates bright/dark"},{"id":"p17s16","text":" water ripples radiating outward.
- **Max pixel field** — at `Max` the track becomes an animated pur"},{"id":"p17s17","text":"ple pixel
field with a reveal sweep and flowing cell flicker; the `Max` label uses a
flowing multi-c"},{"id":"p17s18","text":"olor gradient.
